allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R033: the participant did not answer Yes to ever having had periods (0 or 2), so questions 4:2 to 4:9 are not asked -- the ages, the way the periods became regular, the four age-band lists, the temporary stops and the menopause questions are structurally not applicable: single numeric fields carry the missing-numeric sentinel, the text field carries the missing-string sentinel, the band lists keep their three bands with -999, and PeriodsStopped is empty. The dictionary's 'more than 4 occasions' box R0_TempStopMoreThan is also not applicable (R043). Questionnaire p.10 Q4:1: 'If no, go to question 4.10'.

default: S02:p.10 Q4:1 If 'no', go to question 4.10

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R034: in each temporary-stop entry where the participant did not answer Yes (0 or 2) the age, the length, the reason and the further timing details are structurally not applicable and carry the sentinels. Questionnaire p.11 Q4:8: 'If yes, how old were you when your periods stopped temporarily?'. It is written here, not in the entry's own allOf, to keep the menstrual routings together.

default: S02:p.11 Q4:8 If yes, how old were you when your periods stopped temporarily?
